description: List loss run extractions created through the API, newest first. Filter by status or creation time. Returns up to `limit` extractions (default 25, max 100) and a `nextCursor`; pass it back as `cursor` to get the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

created_after.description: Only return extractions started after this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous list_extractions call.

status.description: Only return extractions with this status.

name: list_extractions
title: List loss run extractions
